newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA CEO SEES VITALISED COMPETITIVENESS.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA CEO SEES VITALISED COMPETITIVENESS.

text.p: Jorma Ollila, CEO of Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy, said on Tuesday that new products would vitalise competitiveness and that the group had a solid foundation for future success.

"In the early part of 1997, we launched or introduced a host of new products that will vitalise our competitiveness during the year," Ollila said in a statement summary of his speech to Nokia's annual general meeting on Tuesday.
"We ... have a solid foundation also for future success; we look to the future with confidence," Ollila said.
Nokia's market climate had remained favourable in recent months, he said.

"To ensure our future competitiveness we are strongly investing in new growth areas that encompass wireless data communications, broadband and fixed wireless solutions as well as Internet-based network solutions," Ollila said. -- Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 242, news@reuters.fi
